# Work Order 4 Completion Report: Index Migration

### Summary of Changes

Migrated the SQLite index in [`internal/core/index/`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index) from the v1 claims/episodes schema to the v2 entries/anchors/aliases schema while preserving backward compatibility with existing episode and entity tables.

#### 1. Schema Extensions ([`index.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index/index.go#L112-L180))
- **Preserved Existing Tables:** `episodes_fts`, `entities`, `entity_relations`, along with legacy `claims`, `anchors`, `relations`, and `conditions` tables for WO5 cleanup.
- **Added New v2 Tables:**
  - `entries`: Primary knowledge records (id, type, dossier_scope, text, source, verified, closes_when, created_at, updated_at).
  - `entries_fts`: FTS5 external content table over `entries` with synchronization triggers (`entries_ai`, `entries_ad`, `entries_au`).
  - `entry_anchors`: Anchor mappings (entry_id, anchor, kind, fingerprint) with index on `anchor`.
  - `error_patterns`: Failure signature patterns with command prefix and dossier scope.
  - `aliases`: Dossier alias mappings (old_scope, new_scope, created_at).
  - `entry_history`: Historical retired and superseded entries.

#### 2. Entry CRUD & Search ([`entries.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index/entries.go))
- Implemented `UpsertEntry(ctx, entry)`: Atomically upserts an entry and associated anchors.
- Implemented `GetEntry(ctx, id)`: Fetches an entry and populates its anchors.
- Implemented `DeleteEntry(ctx, id)`: Deletes an entry and associated anchors/patterns.
- Implemented `ListEntriesByScope(ctx, scope)`: Lists all entries in a dossier scope.
- Implemented `SearchEntries(ctx, query)`: Queries `entries_fts` via FTS5 BM25 ranking.

#### 3. Anchor Lookups ([`entry_anchors.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index/entry_anchors.go))
- Implemented `UpsertEntryAnchors(ctx, entryID, anchors)`: Replaces all anchors for an entry.
- Implemented `LookupByAnchor(ctx, anchor)`: Prefix-matching anchor lookup using `LIKE 'pattern%'`.
- Implemented `LookupByAnchorExact(ctx, anchor)`: Exact-match anchor lookup.

#### 4. Error Patterns ([`entries.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index/entries.go#L295-L352))
- Defined `type ErrorPatternResult`.
- Implemented `InsertErrorPattern(ctx, entryID, commandPrefix, pattern, scope)`.
- Implemented `LookupErrorPatterns(ctx, commandPrefix)`: Finds matching failure-signature patterns for command prefixes.

#### 5. Aliases & History ([`entries.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index/entries.go#L354-L460))
- Implemented `UpsertAlias(ctx, oldScope, newScope)`.
- Implemented `ResolveAlias(ctx, scope)`: Follows alias chains up to 10 hops with cycle detection.
- Implemented `InsertHistory(ctx, entry, reason)` and `GetHistory(ctx, entryID)`.

#### 6. Rebuild from Op Log ([`rebuild.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index/rebuild.go#L164-L315))
- Implemented `RebuildFromOpLog(ctx, opsReader)`:
  - Clears all v2 tables and FTS index.
  - Projects dossiers using `dossiers.NewProjector(opsReader).Project(ctx)`.
  - Upserts entries and anchors.
  - Registers error patterns for failure signatures.
  - Inserts retired/superseded entries into history.
  - Builds aliases from `config.BuildAliasMap`.
  - Rebuilds FTS5 index.
- Preserved existing `Rebuild` function and added `RebuildV1Index` / `RebuildIndex` aliases.

#### 7. Verification ([`v2_test.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.k31n2fgSmG/repo/internal/core/index/v2_test.go))
- Tests added covering all new functionality:
  - `TestEntryRoundTrip`
  - `TestSearchEntries`
  - `TestEntryAnchors`
  - `TestErrorPatterns`
  - `TestAliases`
  - `TestHistory`
  - `TestRebuildFromOpLogEndToEnd`
  - `TestEntityBackwardCompatibility`
- Results:
  - `go build ./...` passes
  - `go vet ./internal/core/index/...` passes
  - `go test -v -count=1 ./internal/core/index/...` passes (all 10 tests passed)
